records.request: Review this report and suggest corrections, without rewriting it: Seven of the 20 sites responded, giving a response rate of 40% [Survey Table 1]. The table says responding sites 7; invited sites 20. That table documents responses only. The review proves the new process caused better retention. Renewal remains subject to board approval.
records.actual_output:
Two corrections are needed:

- “Seven of the 20 sites responded, giving a response rate of 40%”: 7 ÷ 20 is 35%, so correct the percentage to 35% while retaining the supplied counts and citation.
- “The review proves the new process caused better retention”: the supplied table documents responses only and does not support this causal inference. Evidence for retention and causation has not been supplied. Seek appropriate evidence or qualify the claim transparently; do not invent a result or treat the claim as disproved.

Keep “Renewal remains subject to board approval”, which preserves the approval condition.
records.scope_decision: Review and suggested transparent corrections only; calculate supplied arithmetic and assess the supplied citation scope; no external fact-check.

records.request: BGM AI Check: review this team note, then give a portable brief for a later BGM Humanize It edit. Do not rewrite now. records.actual_output:
“It will definitely arrive tomorrow” contradicts the supplied source: there is no confirmed delivery date. “The file is being checked” is clear and should remain substantively intact. The sample is casual, while the requested tone is calm and professional; its slang should not be copied.

Portable editing brief:

- Use BGM Humanize It for a light edit of this original draft: “The file is being checked. It will definitely arrive tomorrow.”
- Audience: the team. Tone: calm and professional.
- Authoritative facts: we are checking the file; there is no confirmed delivery date.
- Resolve the unsupported delivery promise transparently. Preserve the checking status and do not invent a deadline or a new commitment.
- Treat “I'll sort it this arvo, no dramas” as a style sample only. Do not import its promise or slang.
- Return a concise team note when editing is authorised. No rewrite has been made here.
records.scope_decision: Review plus portable editing brief; original text preserved in hand-off; actual installed partner instructions inspected, but no edit performed.
